infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KUWAI uses your camera so you can take photos and record videos to share in your posts and circles. For example, you can snap a photo of an event in Kuwait and post it directly to your feed.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KUWAI accesses your photo library so you can choose existing photos and videos to attach to your posts. For example, you can select up to 4 photos from your camera roll to share with your followers.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: KUWAI saves photos and videos to your library when you download media shared in posts. For example, a video shared in a circle can be saved directly to your Photos app.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: KUWAI uses your microphone to record audio when you create video posts. For example, when recording a video to share in your feed, your microphone captures the accompanying audio.
